selection_rule: At most three candidate papers; require complete DOE inputs and measured responses, at least two responses including etch rate, and paper-side ANOVA or regression coefficients.

sources.citation: R. Legtenberg, H. Jansen, M. de Boer, and M. Elwenspoek, Anisotropic Reactive Ion Etching of Silicon Using SF6/O2/CHF3 Gas Mixtures, Journal of The Electrochemical Society 142(6), 2020-2028 (1995).
sources.source_location: Thesis Chapter 4 reproduces the journal article; PDF pages 85-89 contain Tables 4.1-4.4.

sources.citation: M. F. A. Muttalib, R. Y. Chen, S. J. Pearce, and M. D. B. Charlton, Optimization of reactive-ion etching parameters for fabrication of tantalum pentoxide waveguide using Taguchi method, EPJ Web of Conferences 162, 01003 (2017).
sources.rejection_reason: No ANOVA or regression coefficient table. Printed Table 2 pressure assignments are not orthogonal and conflict with the pressure-level means in Table 4.

sources.citation: G. D. Tipton et al., Optimization of an Electron Cyclotron Resonance Plasma Etch Process for n+ Polysilicon: HBr Process Chemistry, SAND-93-1856C (1993).
sources.rejection_reason: The 20-run RSM factor ranges and model coefficients are present, but the complete run-by-run measured response table is absent.
